annotationMethod: Rule truth was reviewed separately from exact alpha acquisition; no alpha-padding rule is executable in this slice.

cases.semanticQuestion: Does asymmetric transparent padding make the compass asset visually misaligned?
falsePositiveRisks: Optical centering can intentionally differ from rectangular inset equality.
A consuming layout can compensate for source padding.
cases.rationale: The standalone source does not provide its layout role, alignment target, or padding policy.

cases.semanticQuestion: Does hidden RGB under zero alpha change the asset's UI quality?
falsePositiveRisks: Zero-alpha RGB may be preserved intentionally for authoring or later transforms.
Source alpha geometry is invariant under this mutation.
cases.rationale: Hidden RGB is not displayed under the declared alpha predicate and no downstream transformation is known.

cases.semanticQuestion: Are the added transparent margins an alignment or spacing defect?
falsePositiveRisks: Export canvases can intentionally reserve transparent space.
Layout constraints may use the source canvas rather than visible ink.
cases.rationale: The targeted acquisition mutation does not supply an applicable product policy.

cases.semanticQuestion: Does visible right-edge contact prove clipping or invalid padding?
falsePositiveRisks: The source canvas does not reveal placement or clipping in a consuming UI.
cases.rationale: Exact edge occupancy alone cannot distinguish deliberate composition from a defect.

cases.semanticQuestion: Does transparent padding violate an alignment policy when the asset has no visible samples?
falsePositiveRisks: Invisible placeholders or empty animation frames may be valid.
Inventing a zero ink rectangle creates false geometry.
cases.rationale: There is no visible content to which an ink-padding obligation can apply.
